## Elpizo Angel (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
NG Medium outsider (angel, extraplanar, good)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +10  
**Aura** aura of hope, lesser protective aura  


**Offense**


**AC** 15, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+4 natural, +1 Dex, +2 deflect vs. evil)  
**hp** 55 (5d10+5)  
**Fort** +2, **Ref** +5, **Will** +6; +4 vs. poison, +2 resistance vs. evil  
**DR** 5/evil; Immune acid, cold, and petrification; **Resist** electricity 5, fire 5; **SR** 15  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (average)  
**Melee** 2 slams +6 (1d4+1)  
**Special Attacks** bardic performance 17 rounds/day (countersong, distraction, fascinate, inspire competence +2, inspire courage +2)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 5th; concentration +8)  


**At will**-lesser good hope  

3/day—calm emotions, remove despair, saving finale  

1/day—eagle’s splendor, encouragement, gallant inspiration, good hope  



**Statistics**


**Str** 11, **Dex** 12, **Con** 13, **Int** 10, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 16  
**Base Attack** +5; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 16  
**Feats** Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perform), Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Bluff +11, Knowledge (history) +8, Knowledge (planes) +11, Knowledge (religion) +8, Perception +10, Perform (oratory) +14  
**Languages** Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; truespeech  
**SQ** change shape (any humanoid), limned in light, versatile performance  


**Special Abilities**


**Aura of Hope (Su)** An elpizo angel exudes a 30 ft. aura of hope. All creatures within the aura gain a +2 bonus against fear and despair effects and if they are under the effects of a despair or fear effect, they gain an immediate save against the effect with the added bonus upon entering the aura or the turn after being affected while in the aura.  

**Bardic Performance (Su)** An elpizo has the bardic performance ability of a 5th-level bard.  

**Lesser Protective Aura (Su)** An elpizo has a lesser form of the protective aura possessed by more powerful angels. This protective aura grants the guiding light a +2 deflection bonus to its AC against evil foes, and a +2 resistance bonus on all saving throws made against evil effects or spells cast by evil creatures. This aura extends to a radius of 5 feet, but can only benefit one additional creature other than the elpizo at any one time. An elpizo’s protective aura is fragile, and as soon as an evil creature successfully strikes the elpizo, or as soon as it fails a saving throw against an evil source, its protective aura fades away and is no longer applicable. The elpizo can reactivate its protective aura by spending 1 minute concentrating upon the task.  

**Limned in Light (Ex)** An elpizo is limned in a glowing light that illuminates as a candle. This is always active while the elpizo is in their natural form.  

**Versatile Performance (Su)** An Elpizo has the bard’s versatile performance ability, using its Perform (oratory) bonus in place of its Diplomacy and Sense Motive.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any good-aligned plane  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or comfort (3-6)  
**Treasure** standard
